dataset_contract.contamination_check: candidate-family freshness is checked BEFORE any read

mission: ARENA RESEARCH GENERATION 2 — FX SESSION CANDIDATE V1 (6h dev-only sprint)

BOOTSTRAP_UNCERTAINTY.pass_rule: 95% CI lower bound of management expectancy R strictly > 0

CANDIDATE_IDENTITY_VALIDATION.pass_rule: all contract hashes recomputed and equal; strategy identity collides with no historical candidate id

DATASET_ROLE_VALIDATION.pass_rule: every dataset read is role=DEVELOPMENT, recorded in the dataset ledger; OOS_OPENED=NO; HOLDOUT_TOUCHED=NO

FRICTION_READINESS.note: FRICTION_EDGE_VERIFICATION_READY = NO does not block STRUCTURAL research (mission section 13)
FRICTION_READINESS.pass_rule: the friction authority state is explicitly recorded, economic metrics are suppressed as NOT_ESTIMABLE_NO_FRICTION_AUTHORITY, and NO substitute value (generic spread, $7/lot, fixed slippage, industry default) appears anywhere in the evidence bundle

MEAN_MEDIAN_DIVERGENCE.pass_rule: NOT (mean management R > 0 AND median management R < 0) — a positive mean carried entirely by tails fails

PARAMETER_NEIGHBORHOOD.method: ag_edgelab.optimization.stability.assess_parameter_stability over displacement body/range in [0.6, 0.65, 0.7, 0.75, 0.8] centred on 0.7
PARAMETER_NEIGHBORHOOD.selection_authority: NONE — diagnostic only; the V1 threshold 0.70 is frozen and is NOT changed by this mission under any outcome

REGIME_STABILITY.classifier: ag_edgelab.verification.regimes.classify_market_state (frozen v1) applied to the D1 bar last closed before the entry-window open
REGIME_STABILITY.pass_rule: fraction of qualifying regime slices with positive management expectancy >= 0.6

SESSION_STABILITY.pass_rule: fraction of qualifying session pairs with positive management expectancy >= 0.6

SYMBOL_STABILITY.pass_rule: fraction of qualifying symbols with positive management expectancy >= 0.6

TAIL_DEPENDENCE.method: remove the single best trade; separately remove the best 5% of trades
TAIL_DEPENDENCE.pass_rule: pooled management expectancy stays strictly positive under BOTH removals

WALK_FORWARD.method: chronological non-overlapping DEV folds (monthly test windows)
WALK_FORWARD.pass_rule: fraction of folds with positive management expectancy >= 0.6

YEAR_STABILITY.method: the committed FX authority covers ONE calendar year (2017); per config/governance/data_authority_gap.json no multi-year partition exists. Substitution declared in advance: INTRA_YEAR_SEGMENT_STABILITY over the DEV calendar quarters (2017Q1, 2017Q2, 2017Q3-partial).
YEAR_STABILITY.pass_rule: fraction of qualifying quarters with positive management expectancy >= 0.6

pre_oos_gate.semantics: FAIL_CLOSED — the gate PASSES only if every axis is PASS

structural_capability_floors.source: frozen V0.3 root-cause thresholds in ag_edgelab.universal.fx_dev_campaign

decision_order.label: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE
decision_order.note: reported first as a measurement-capability statement, but the funnel stage that produced the starvation is still named

decision_order.label: TEMPORAL_INCOMPATIBILITY
decision_order.rule: the dominant rejection reason among TRIGGER-passing candidates is a window-bounded failure (NO_MSS_BOS_AFTER_DISPLACEMENT, NO_FRESH_FVG_AFTER_MSS, NO_CAUSAL_RETRACE_INTO_FVG) AND the median number of M15 bars remaining in the entry window after the reclaim bar is below the number of sequential events the contract still requires

decision_order.label: TRIGGER_FUNNEL_WEAKNESS
decision_order.rule: opportunity-basis reach of the maximum measured target among TRIGGER-passing candidates <= 20.0 pct, i.e. the selected population never had the capability that confirmation is being asked to find

decision_order.label: CONFIRMATION_FUNNEL_WEAKNESS
decision_order.rule: a CONFIRMATION node passes <= 10.0 pct of its input while its target uplift vs input is <= 3.0 pp (attrition without selection value)

decision_order.label: TARGET_MODEL_MISMATCH
decision_order.rule: median natural_target_R < 1.0 or the TP1/TP2 structural model is unreachable for > 85.0 pct of entries while 1R capability is healthy (>= 0.5)

decision_order.label: TARGET_CONTINUATION_WEAKNESS
decision_order.rule: 1R capability >= 0.5 but 3R capability < 0.25 (frozen V0.3 continuation-collapse rule)

root_cause_contract.upstream_principle: If confirmation optimization cannot produce viable target capability, the TRIGGER weakness is diagnosed FIRST and no further confirmation filters are added.

allowed: diagnostic comparisons defined by the Universal Funnel Analyzer
search_policy.on_failure: REJECT — a V2 hypothesis may only be designed later under a NEW preregistration

confirmation_contract.close_back_inside: first M15 bar at or after the sweep whose CLOSE is strictly inside the Asian range

displacement.rule: body / candle_range >= 0.70 AND body polarity matches the thesis

fresh_fvg.freshness: third candle closes strictly after the MSS bar close and within 12 M5 bars

mss_bos.rule: first direction-matched MSS or BOS at or after the displacement bar

retrace.invalidation: if the structural stop is touched before the FVG, the candidate is rejected
retrace.rule: first causal M5 touch of the FVG strictly after the gap's third candle closes

confirmation_contract.sweep: M15 bar trades beyond the Asian boundary on the non-direction side
confirmation_contract.temporal_envelope: every funnel event INCLUDING the entry fill must occur inside the session entry window

entry_contract.fill_policy: LIMIT_AT_FVG_PROXIMAL_EDGE_ON_FIRST_CAUSAL_TOUCH — fill price is the proximal FVG edge (upper edge for LONG, lower edge for SHORT) on the first M5 bar that trades into the gap strictly after the gap's third candle closes. Outcome measurement starts at the NEXT M5 bar; if the fill bar itself also trades through the structural stop the candidate is recorded STOPPED_SAME_BAR = -1R (fail-closed).
entry_contract.outcome_anchor: M5 bar AFTER the fill bar

strategy_contract.execution_capability: NONE — no broker adapter, no order sending, no EA import

session_contract.note: Both evaluated session pairs use the SAME Asian reference range (00:00-06:00 UTC) as the liquidity object, because the hypothesis is Asian-liquidity displacement. The pair label names the ENTRY window: ASIAN_LONDON = London entry window 07:00-10:00 UTC, LONDON_NEWYORK = New York entry window 12:00-15:00 UTC. Windows are frozen and are NEVER widened in response to observed results.

sl_contract.note: Structural stop ONLY: LONG SL = sweep bar low, SHORT SL = sweep bar high. No pip/point buffer is added. Execution/spread buffering belongs to the friction layer, which has no authority in this mission.

target_contract.censoring_policy: RIGHT_CENSORED_DATA_BOUNDARY_EXPLICIT — a candidate whose 288-M5-bar outcome window is truncated by the DEVELOPMENT partition end is RIGHT_CENSORED: excluded from target-capability denominators, counted in the population, never imputed. The OOS partition is NEVER read to complete an outcome window.
target_contract.economic_claim: FORBIDDEN — no friction authority exists (structural R only)
target_contract.management_diagnostic: 50% at TP1, 50% toward TP2, original structural SL retained by the runner
target_contract.tp2: nearest valid H1 liquidity objective strictly beyond TP1 (closed H1 bars only)

trigger_contract.composite_rule: BULL iff D1==BULL and H4!=BEAR and H1==BULL; BEAR iff D1==BEAR and H4!=BULL and H1==BEAR; else NEUTRAL
trigger_contract.decision_anchor: entry window open (UTC); only bars CLOSED at or before the anchor are readable
primary_trigger: Asian liquidity swept on the opposite side
M15 close back inside the Asian range
recorded_but_non_gating: H1 liquidity pool counts above/below price
trigger_contract.sweep_side_rule: direction MUST NOT equal sweep side: BULL sweeps the Asian LOW, BEAR the Asian HIGH
